dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001230\_41](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001230) Category 1 during the period Oct 21 2025-Oct 31 2025 in Jamaica, Cuba, Bahamas, Bermuda, Haiti, Canada. The center of the storm was located near latitude 39.0 longitude -60.5. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
